name.zh: 中断检测 / 超时兜底

change.zh: 基线 95 % 在 10 s 发现、其余 60 s 超时 → 99.9 % 在 1 s 发现、其余 60 s；只改变停机中的发现时间
change.en: baseline 95 % detected in 10 s, rest by a 60 s timeout → 99.9 % in 1 s, rest 60 s; only the detection part of the outage changes

change.zh: 95 % 在 5 min 发现 → 99 % 在 30 s 发现；漏检仍降速 24 h；恢复仍 3 min、零回滚
change.en: 95 % detected in 5 min → 99 % in 30 s; undetected units stay slow for 24 h; recovery unchanged (3 min, no rollback)

change.zh: 预测器召回 50 % 的即将发生的中断，在下一个 checkpoint 做计划内迁移（180 s 停顿、不回滚、无检测时延）；精度 80 %，误报按 r(1 − p)/p 增加同样的停顿
change.en: the predictor catches 50 % of impending interruptions, which become planned migrations at the next checkpoint (180 s pause, no rollback, no detection delay); precision 80 %, false alarms add the same pause at r(1 − p)/p per interruption

name.zh: 容错集合通信 / 多网卡切换

change.zh: 网卡或链路故障在一次迭代内被集合通信库吸收：95 % 在 2 s 内切换、不回滚、无检测时延；失败耗时 10 s 后进入检测与恢复链
change.en: NIC or link failures are absorbed inside the collective: 95 % fail over in 2 s with no rollback and no detection delay; a failure costs 10 s before the normal detection and chain

name.zh: 故障卡热替换（零开销 checkpoint）
name.en: Hot-swap of failed devices with zero-overhead checkpoints

change.zh: 卡 / 服务器级中断 90 % 在 180 s 内由备用设备热替换、不回滚；失败 60 s 后进入弹性 / 进程 / 全局
change.en: card / server interruptions are hot-swapped from a spare in 180 s with 90 % success and no rollback; a failure costs 60 s before elastic / process / global

change.zh: 暴露保存时间降到 0.5 s、每 60 s 一次；从主机 / 邻居内存加载使全局恢复缩短 60 s；主机内存与流量干扰计 1 % 开销
change.en: exposed save time 0.5 s every 60 s; loading from host / peer memory shortens the global recovery by 60 s; host-memory and traffic interference cost 1 % of throughput

change.zh: 即时检出 0 % → 95 %，检测 1 s；仅启用检测时回到现有干净 CKPT 并用全局恢复；漏检仍 120 h 后发现
change.en: immediate detection 0 % → 95 % after 1 s; the job rolls back to the last checkpoint and runs the global recovery; the remaining 5 % are still found after 120 h

name.zh: 干净状态恢复与 step 重算

change.zh: 已即时检出的静默从全局 CKPT / 3 min 恢复 → 易失干净 step 状态 / 1 s 恢复，最多重做 1 s 计算；不缩短漏检的兜底
change.en: a detected corruption recovers from the volatile clean step state in 1 s and redoes at most 1 s instead of the global checkpoint recovery; the fallback for undetected corruption is unchanged

change.zh: 瞬态中断先重执行：90 % 在 5 s 成功且不回滚；失败耗时 10 s 后进入后续恢复链
change.en: transient interruptions are re-executed first: 90 % succeed in 5 s without rollback; a failure costs 10 s and continues down the chain

change.zh: 适用中断 95 % 在 60 s 重建进程，仍全局暂停并回滚 CKPT；失败 120 s 后全局 CKPT
change.en: 95 % of applicable interruptions rebuild the process in 60 s (global pause, rollback to the checkpoint); a failure costs 120 s before the global recovery

change.zh: 适用中断 98 % 局部恢复成功：50 域中一个域 180 s 不可用，全局协调 1 s；状态冗余避免回滚；失败 120 s 后后续全局恢复
change.en: 98 % of applicable interruptions recover locally: one of 50 domains is out for 180 s, the job pauses 1 s to re-synchronise; redundant state avoids rollback; a failure costs 120 s before the next rung

name.zh: 缩短 CKPT 周期和保存阻塞

change.zh: 每计算 300 s 保存 4 s → 每计算 60 s 保存 1 s；同时改变保存开销与回滚
change.en: save 4 s every 300 s of compute → save 1 s every 60 s; both the save overhead and the rollback change

name.zh: 自动恢复尝试时间 → 下限
自动恢复成功率 → 上限
人工恢复时间 → 下限
